recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping cron on edna and adding a wrapper that pings an external hosted heartbeat service such as Healthchecks.io on start, success and failure, so the user is alerted when nightly-sync fails or doesn't run, then testing both a crash and a missed run.
note: The only thing to set up now is one external heartbeat alert; the local log is kept for diagnosis, Synology log collection is put off until later and running a monitor in Docker on the NAS is not recommended, but none of the four labelled lines appear.
